نمتر (form VIII)
# نَمْتَرِ (namtari) /nam.ta.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# نُمْتَرَ (numtara) /num.ta.ra/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
